I’m happy to help you keep track of what’s coming out!  
Because my training only goes through **June 2024**, I don’t have real‑world information on titles released after that point—so I can’t tell you exactly which movies hit theaters in late 2024, all of 2025, or into 2026.  

Below is a quick snapshot of the most highly anticipated releases that were announced before mid‑2024, plus a few “next‑up” projects that had been slated for later this year or early next year when my data was cut off:

| Title | Studio / Distributor | Release window (as scheduled) |
|-------|----------------------|--------------------------------|
| *Avatar V* | Disney/Pixar | Q1 2025 (originally planned for 2027) |
| *The Marvels* | Marvel Studios | July 2025 |
| *Mission: Impossible – Dead Reckoning Part Two* | Paramount Pictures | August 2025 |
| *Oppenheimer* (sequel speculation) | Warner Bros. | TBD |
| *Spider‑Man: Across the Spider‑Verse* (Part II) | Sony & Netflix | Late 2025 |
| *Star Wars: Rogue Squadron* | Lucasfilm | Early 2026 |
| *Indiana Jones 5* | Lucasfilm | Mid‑2026 |

**How to get the freshest lineup**

If you’re looking for the very newest releases right now (late 2025–early 2026), here are a couple of reliable ways to stay up‑to‑date:

1. **IMDb Upcoming Releases** – Their calendar shows official theatrical windows worldwide.  
   👉 https://www.imdb.com/calendar/

2. **Rotten Tomatoes’ “New Movies” section** – Updated daily with trailers, posters, and premiere dates.  
   👉 https://www.rottentomatoes.com/movies/new

3. **Film festivals** – Cannes, Toronto, Venice, SXSW, etc., often announce their lineups months ahead. Checking festival websites gives clues about future wide releases.

4. **Studio press releases** – Major studios post schedules directly on their corporate pages (e.g., Disney+ Newsroom, Warner Bros. Press).

Feel free to let me know if there’s a particular genre, franchise, or actor you’re interested in—I can pull up the relevant slate based on the data available up to June 2024.
